title: WorkerPublishRunRequest
description: The body of the worker's POST /publish: which finished run to publish, and its hand-written review. A worker keeps no review store, so the review is sent inline. The worker loads the run's record and collected implementation from its output directory, then runs the full publish — release the source repo, deploy the build, and submit the record + review + resolved links to the backend — exactly as a local `tcab publish` does. Idempotent on the run id. A missing or invalid rating is a `422`; an unknown run is a `404`.

runId.description: The id of a run this worker previously produced. Its record and collected implementation are loaded from the worker's output directory.

ratings.description: The reviewer's quality rating for each of the test case's declared scoring domains. The run's overall rating is the worst across them.

writeup.description: The markdown writeup body shown before the playable build, with any rating and checklist frontmatter stripped. Must be non-empty — a run cannot be published without a review.

checklist.description: The reviewer's verdicts on the test case's declared reviewer checklist items (see the version manifest's reviewItems). One entry per declared item; publishing refuses a run whose review leaves any declared item without a verdict. Empty or omitted for a case that declares no items.
